scope: Expanded lexical candidates, not exhaustive all-card semantic proof.

card.name: Judging Light
card.effect: Judging Light. Tags: smite, passive. When your Divine Smite damages a creature currently affected by a Cursed or Weakened condition, add S d4 radiant damage to that Smite. Roll these dice once as part of the Smite; they do not create a second hit or trigger.

source.originalText: Judging Light: Smite deals +20% bonus damage to enemies afflicted by Cursed or Weakened effects.

card.name: Judgment
card.frequency: Automatic only if Judgment was selected
card.effect: Invocation Path — Judgment. Tags: invocation, judgment, smite. When your Divine Smite deals damage to a creature, mark it Judged for 2 rounds. A Judged creature has -1 AC. Further applications refresh the duration but do not increase the AC penalty.

source.originalText: Judgment: Smites mark enemies with Judged for 2 rounds, reducing their AC by 1.

card.name: Celestial Resurgence
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to six allied corpses within 30 feet that died during the previous 3 rounds
card.effect: Final Miracle — Celestial Resurgence. Tags: saint, finale, resurrection, rite. Each legal target returns to life at 1 HP. The body must be sufficiently present to sustain life. This removes no Wounds, curses or other death consequences. Divine Rebirth may modify one returned ally if available. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once under the common rule.

source.originalText: Final Miracle: Celestial Resurgence: Revive all allies who died within the last 3 turns.

card.name: Balanced Scales
card.rangeAndTarget: Living creatures healed by your Cleric features
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per marked ally per round
card.effect: Balanced Scales. Tags: priest, healing, retaliation. After you restore HP to a living ally, mark it until the start of your next regular turn. The first enemy to damage that ally during the mark takes S + M radiant damage. The retaliation is not an attack, cannot critically hit and cannot recursively trigger another Balanced Scales event.

source.originalText: Balanced Scales: Enemies take divine damage if they attack healed targets.

card.name: Word of Binding
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to six enemies within 30 feet
card.effect: Final Miracle — Word of Binding. Tags: priest, finale, control, rite. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Silenced and its Speed becomes 0. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending both effects on success. While a target remains bound, the first instance of divine or radiant damage it takes each round gains S d6 additional radiant damage. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Final Miracle: Word of Binding: Enemies in a large AoE are silenced, snared, and take +25% divine damage for 3 turns.

card.name: Divine Judgment
card.effect: Divine Judgment. Tags: priest, judgment. The target makes a Wisdom save; success ends the attempt. On failure it is marked. The first time on each of its turns that it deals damage to another creature, it takes radiant damage equal to half that actual damage rounded down, minimum 1, maximum your Cleric level. It repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each turn, ending the mark on success.

source.originalText: Divine Judgment: Mark an enemy for judgment, causing them to take damage proportional to the harm they inflict.

card.name: Ritual of Undeath
card.rangeAndTarget: One eligible corpse within 30 feet or one living ally within 30 feet
card.effect: Ritual of Undeath. Tags: cultist, undead, rite. Choose one mode. Corpse Servant: one humanoid corpse dead no more than 1 minute rises for 3 rounds as a temporary thrall with AC 13, 10 HP, Speed 30 feet and one attack only when you spend your shared companion Bonus Action command using your Cleric technique attack bonus; on hit it deals S d6 necrotic. The thrall disappears at 0 HP or when duration ends and grants no XP, loot, new corpse, Conviction or resurrection target. Death Ward: one living ally is marked for 1 minute; the first time it would die during that duration, it instead remains at 1 HP and counts as both humanoid and undead until the end of its next turn. Neither mode removes Wounds. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Ritual of Undeath: Perform a forbidden ritual that can temporarily raise fallen enemies as servants or prevent allies from dying by transforming them into undead-like entities.

records.text: One Blood Mark at a time on a living target with your Bleed, except Phantom Strike, which explicitly may apply the mark without Bleed. It does not add a free Bleed. Marks last 5 of your regular turns, expire on encounter end or if the target dies, and never create damage by themselves. Rupture requires the target still within 60 ft and line of effect; it spends the mark. A mark does not defeat cover, planar boundaries or bloodlessness. Bloodtrail has its own tracking limits.

At level 1 learn the core Blood Gauge/Bleed rules automatically. Blood Mark and Veinweaver's Core remain selections; Quickblood can be selected and used without a second unlock tax. Veinweaver's Core improves that foundation as printed. Standard scheduled acquisition applies. Bloodbound Edge is automatic 9. At 10 choose Bloodweaver, Shadow Operative or Thirstborn; its Final Cut is automatic 20. Duplicate Hemostasis names are separate Arch and Bloodweaver IDs.

card.name: Blood Mark
card.rangeAndTarget: One living target with your Bleed within 60 ft
card.effect: Apply your Blood Mark. Replaces your previous mark without detonating it. The mark enables Rupture and printed mark interactions; it deals no automatic damage and does not grant vision.

source.originalText: Blood Mark: Apply a magical mark to a bleeding target that lasts for 5 turns. The mark can be detonated for additional effects.

card.name: Rupture Trigger
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 other enemies within 5 ft of ruptured mark
card.effect: After Rupture damages its marked target, choose up to 2 other living enemies nearby. Each makes CON save; on failure apply one Bleed. These applications do not trigger Rupture again or grant BG.

source.originalText: Rupture Trigger: Detonating a Blood Mark causes AoE Bleed in a small radius.

card.name: Rupture
card.effect: Target makes CON save: (S+1)d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. The mark ends either way; existing Bleed remains. Damage from this technique is not a weapon hit and grants no BG.

source.originalText: Rupture: Detonate a Blood Mark on a target, dealing significant damage and consuming the mark.

card.name: Purify Blood
card.effect: End Poisoned and one nonmagical disease. Magical disease needs a successful INT ability check against its stated treatment DC, or DC 15 if absent; failure spends the cost. No curse, Wound, death or Corruption removal.

source.originalText: Purify Blood: Remove poison, disease, or other blood-borne afflictions from a target.

card.name: Phantom Strike
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in weapon reach; must be hidden from it
card.effect: Make one weapon attack with advantage. On hit add S d6 damage and apply a mark without its usual BG cost, even if not already bleeding. The mark replaces your old mark; no free Rupture occurs. Normal hit BG gain still capped.

source.originalText: Phantom Strike: Attack from stealth with increased critical chance and apply a Blood Mark automatically.

card.name: Hemorrhagic Plague
card.rangeAndTarget: One new living enemy within 5 ft of a Bleed victim
card.effect: After one of your Bleeds ticks, pay 1 BG; new target makes CON save. Failure applies one Bleed. A spread instance cannot spread again. This grants no BG and does not duplicate marks or immediate damage.

source.originalText: Hemorrhagic Plague: Bleeds automatically spread to nearby enemies every 3 turns.

card.name: Carrion Conductor
card.rangeAndTarget: One fresh hostile living-combatant corpse within 30 ft
card.effect: Mark the corpse once; on activation or before expiry use Reaction to burst it. Up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX saves: S d6 necrotic, half on success. Corpse cannot be reused, raised by this effect or provide BG/kill triggers.

source.originalText: Carrion Conductor: Corpses leave behind blood pools that explode for AoE damage.

card.name: Draconic Discipline
card.effect: Gain advantage on saves against being knocked Prone or forcibly moved. It does not protect against Stunned, spell damage or grappling unless the save also imposes one of those named effects.

source.originalText: Draconic Discipline: Gain +10% resistance to knockback and crowd control.

card.name: Aegis Leap
card.rangeAndTarget: Ally within 15 ft targeted by an attack
card.effect: Before the attack roll, leap to an empty space adjacent to ally using this supplied movement. Become the target if the attack can reach you; resolve against your AC. Cannot be used if restrained or no path. Counts as your one intercept reaction.

source.originalText: Aegis Leap: Leap to an ally and intercept the next attack made against them.

card.name: Drake Mark
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your leap
card.effect: Mark that creature; your first subsequent direct polearm hit adds S damage. A new mark replaces old. No extra damage to the triggering leap, Do Ts or copies; it is not a spell mark.

source.originalText: Drake Mark: Each leap attack marks enemies. Marked enemies take +10% damage from you.

card.name: Tyrant's Impale
card.duration: Instant; pin until end next turn
card.effect: Weapon attack; hit adds S d6 piercing. A hit creature no more than one size larger makes STR save or is Restrained and Bleeding. It may use Action STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) versus class DC to end restraint. You must stay in reach to maintain pin.

source.originalText: Tyrant's Impale: A devastating attack that can pin weaker enemies to the ground, preventing movement and causing bleeding damage.

source.originalText:
Timeless Body
Starting at 18th level, the primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

card.name: Nature's Ward
card.effect: Immune to Charmed/Frightened from fey/elementals, poison damage, Poisoned and disease. Does not suppress all creature abilities or remove an existing curse.

source.originalText:
Nature's Ward
When you reach 10th level, you can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

card.name: Tanglemaw
card.rangeAndTarget: Land Hero; bite 5 ft; sense 30 ft
card.effect: Bite 2d6+WIS piercing, STR save or Restrained until end next turn, escape Action against DC. Thorny Body deals 1d4 piercing to one melee attacker after hit; no reflections. Sense ground-contact locations 30 ft on same connected surface, not identities through stone walls.

card.name: Winter's Embrace
card.effect: Up to 3 enemies starting turn inside CON save or 1d6 cold and Speed-10 ft through end turn. Once/enemy/round; success no effect. Does not stack multiple slows or affect flying targets outside sphere.

As a bonus action, you can activate this aura, causing each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. card.name: Purifying Beam
card.effect: Purifying Beam. Tags: mage-spell, archmage, radiant, cleansing. Enemies in the line make Dexterity saves, taking (S+1)d8 radiant damage on failure or half on success. Up to M allies in the line may each end one of Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned. Cleansing does not remove Wounds, curses or disease unless another rule expressly allows it. This non-Focus spell clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Purifying Beam: Channel a beam of radiant arcane energy that damages enemies and cleanses negative effects from allies.

card.name: Undead Immunities
card.effect: Undead Immunities. Tags: lich, undead. You are immune to poison damage, the Poisoned condition, disease, Frightened, Charmed and magical sleep. You no longer need to breathe. You still require the normal rest schedule for mechanical recovery and can still be affected by abilities that specifically target undead unless another feature says otherwise.

source.originalText: Undead Immunities: Become immune to poison, disease, fear, sleep, and mind control.

card.name: Light Binding
card.effect: Choose mode: enemies make STR save or Restrained; they repeat save at turn end. OR up to 2 allies gain S d6+M temporary HP. No mixed modes; bonds are magical and not permanent objects.

source.originalText: Light Binding: Create bonds of radiant energy that can restrain enemies or create protective barriers for allies.

card.name: Purifying Reflection
card.rangeAndTarget: Ally within 30 ft failing save against Charmed/Frightened/Poisoned
card.effect: Ally rerolls that save with advantage; use new result. If it succeeds, it regains S d6 HP. No arbitrary curse or death reversal; costs remain if it fails. This is not a captured Echo and creates no record.

source.originalText: Purifying Reflection: Reflect and purify harmful effects, potentially converting them into healing or beneficial effects.

card.name: Reflected Repertoire
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 records currently in your archive
card.effect: Mark up to 3 distinct existing records. Each one's next release keeps its record instead of consuming it; still pay release RP and obey one release/round. No restoration of already empty slots, no invented records, no reuse-preservation after its marked use.

source.originalText: Final – Reflected Repertoire: Reset all Echo slots. Next 3 Echoes cast without consuming slots.

records.text: STUN GUARD. A creature can be Stunned by your Monk features at most once per encounter. Mark it after the first Monk-caused Stunned condition successfully applies. If another of your Monk features would Stun that marked creature later in the same encounter, the creature still makes the required save; on failure it instead loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. This guard is tracked separately for each Monk.

Each technique tagged weave creates 1 D in this pilot, unless it explicitly says otherwise. Ki can prevent up to 1 D before resolution only if remaining Ki pays that additional cost. Full-Ki capstones may legally accept D. The Stun Guard shares the suite-wide once/character/target hard-denial mark; its later failed-save fallback of reaction loss is an explicit Monk exception, not a second Stun.

card.name: Stunning Strike
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.frequency: Once per target per encounter for Stunned
card.effect: Stunning Strike. Tags: base, active, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the common Monk Stun Guard. On success it suffers only the strike's normal damage. A creature already marked by your Stun Guard instead loses its Reaction on a failed save.

source.originalText: Stunning Strike: Channel ki into a precise strike that can temporarily paralyze an opponent if they fail to resist.

card.name: Serenity Breaker Palm
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within unarmed reach; allies within 10 feet
card.effect: Serenity Breaker Palm. Tags: hero, enlightened, attack, cleanse. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit, choose up to M living allies within 10 feet of you; each may end either Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned. The cleansing occurs only if the strike hits. It removes no Wounds, curses or disease and generates no Ki beyond ordinary attack generators.

source.originalText: Serenity Breaker Palm: Strike enemy; cleanse allies in 2 tiles (3 Ki).

card.name: Healing Touch
card.effect: Healing Touch. Tags: hero, enlightened, healing, weave. The target regains S d8+M HP and may immediately repeat one saving throw against Poisoned or disease if that effect normally permits repeated saves. This does not resurrect, remove Wounds or automatically cure disease. It is a minor Weave technique; the common extra-Ki payment may prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Healing Touch: Channel positive ki energy through your hands to heal injuries and cure minor ailments.

card.name: Purifying Palm
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within unarmed reach; allies within 10 feet
card.effect: Purifying Palm. Tags: hero, enlightened, attack, cleanse. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit choose up to two allies within 10 feet. Each may end Frightened or Poisoned. If you spend one additional Ki after the hit, one chosen ally may instead end Charmed. It removes no curse, disease or Wound.

source.originalText: Purifying Palm: Strike an enemy while simultaneously cleansing negative effects from nearby allies.

card.name: Nerve Strike
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Nerve Strike. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure choose one: its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, or it loses its Reaction and cannot take Bonus Actions during that period. This causes no permanent nerve injury.

source.originalText: Nerve Strike: Target critical pressure points to temporarily disable an opponent's abilities or movement.

records.text: The Oracle is an exceptional progression class rather than a 25-choice Base/Arch/Hero class. Base Oracle is levels 1-2, Revelation Tier development is the Arch-stage progression at levels 3-9, and Revelation Mastery is the Hero-stage progression at levels 10-20. Mystery and Curse are chosen at level 1 but their later Revelations, Boons and Final abilities remain class-level gated.

Choose exactly ONE Mystery and exactly ONE Curse at Oracle level 1. They are not parallel subclasses that stack. You never gain another Mystery or Curse unless a future explicit retraining or transformation rule says otherwise. Curse limitations are permanent and cannot be removed by ordinary cleansing, curse removal, resurrection or rest.

BASE PROGRESSION. At Oracle 1 choose Mystery and Curse; gain the RC engine, Channel Revelation, Prophetic Insight and Divine Sense. At Oracle 2 gain Curse Manifestation, Oracular Trance and Oracle's Burden. No Base feature-selection currency or Skill Points are used.

ARCH-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 3: choose one Tier I Revelation from your Mystery and automatically gain Curse Boon I. Oracle 4: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 5: automatically gain Curse Boon II; any Mystery-specific level-5 feature recorded by the registry belongs to the Mystery module below and does not create an additional generic feature here. Oracle 6: choose one Tier II Revelation and gain Mystery Surge. Oracle 8: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 9: gain your Mystery's fixed Tier III Revelation.

HERO-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 10: gain Curse Boon III and Grand Revelation Foreshadow. Oracle 11: RC cap reaches 7 and the preserved encounter-start RC floor becomes active. Oracle 12: gain the Mystery-specific Mystic Insight. Oracle 13: preserved registry draft grants a second Tier II Revelation; after each completed short rest choose which of your two Tier II Revelations is Attuned for features that specifically refer to an active Tier II option, though both remain known and usable. Oracle 14: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 15: gain Revelation Mastery and Curse Boon IV. Oracle 16: preserved Prophecy Trigger Mastery. Oracle 17: preserved Grand Revelation Foreshadow upgrade. Oracle 18: Prophetic Surge. Oracle 19: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 20: gain the Mystery's Final Revelation and Curse Boon V.

CURSE MANIFESTATION provides a common operational intensification rather than ten different hidden sub-engines. When activated, your Curse becomes visibly or metaphysically dominant for 3 rounds: gain +1 on Revelation attacks and +1 to Revelation save DC, but take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws for the duration. Any Curse limitation that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed during Manifestation.

CURSE BOONS are automatic at Oracle levels 3, 5, 10, 15 and 20 for your ONE selected Curse. You do not choose between Curse Boons and do not gain Boons from unselected Curses. Each Curse card below operationalizes all five Boon gates and its permanent limitations.

All class gates use Oracle class level, not total character level. Normal proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. Non-Oracle levels do not raise RC maximum, unlock Curse Boons, Revelations, Mystic Insight, Revelation Mastery, Prophetic Surge or Final Revelation.

All combat-triggered RC refunds, including Prophecy, damage riders and Curse Boons, share ONE recovered RC per round. Rest recovery, encounter-start floor and explicitly limited Final refills are separate. A free, copied or refunded use cannot recursively trigger another recovery. Apply this global cap even if an individual card says its recovery is separate.

card.name: Oracle's Curse
card.effect: Choose exactly one Curse from the ten Curse cards below. Its limitations apply immediately and cannot be removed by ordinary magic or rest. Its Boons unlock automatically at Oracle levels 3, 5, 10, 15 and 20.

card.name: Curse Manifestation
card.effect: Intensify your chosen Curse. For 3 rounds gain +1 on Revelation attack rolls and +1 to your Revelation save DC. For the same duration take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws. Any part of the selected Curse that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed while Manifestation lasts.

card.name: Oracle's Burden
card.effect: Your selected Curse is recognized as an intrinsic Oracle class condition rather than an ordinary removable curse. Remove Curse, cleansing, resurrection and similar generic effects cannot remove or suspend it. Only a feature that explicitly names your Oracle Curse can suppress, transform or replace one of its effects.

card.name: Spiral-Touched — Boon II
card.effect: resistance to explicitly time/aging damage and advantage on saves against aging/slow effects; once per encounter spend 1 RC after another creature finishes its turn to take one additional full Action immediately, subject to the global action cap.

value.name: Spiral-Touched
limitations: You sometimes respond to events before they happen, causing confusion in social situations

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: See 1 round into the future during initiative (+3 initiative). Once per day, reroll a failed save as you briefly step outside the timestream.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to act out of turn once per combat. You gain resistance to time-based magic and aging effects.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you may instead phase out of time for 1 round, becoming untargetable and regaining 25% of your maximum HP. Once per long rest.

boons.description: You exist in multiple timestreams simultaneously, allowing you to make two different actions in a single turn once per combat. Enemies attacking you have a 10% chance to hit your echo instead, causing the attack to miss.

Once each encounter, before your first damaging Revelation resolves, roll d6: 1 fire, 2 cold, 3 lightning, 4 necrotic, 5 psychic, 6 radiant; that Revelation's damage becomes the rolled type. originalObjects.value: Purifying Crown — once per day, manifest sanctified fire for 3 rounds: undead and fiends in your aura take radiant+fire damage each turn, allies gain immunity to disease and poison, and Holy Inferno immediately recharges once.

card.duration: Temporary HP until lost; root until end of target's next turn

originalObjects.value: Primordial Crown — once per day, Thorn Crown persists for 3 rounds without cost; roots on crit spread to adjacent foes, fey and elementals within aura cannot attack allies, and allies gain advantage on saves vs charm while the crown persists.

value.spell: Chain of Duty — mark ally; teleport to them when they fall

records.text: Dexterity governs weapons; Wisdom governs primal technique DC/M. This draft uses the detailed book's d8 Hit Die; older runtime d10 remains preserved as a conflicting alternative. At 1 gain Track Target engine: Bonus Action mark one perceived enemy within 90 ft for 1 minute, no RP, one quarry at a time; new mark replaces old. Once/own turn a weapon hit against quarry adds S damage. Mark does not reveal creatures through total cover. Track Target selection is an upgrade, not a second unlock tax.

All Rangers learn five bounded Arrows at 11. Emberroot requires the previous 3 successful weapon hits carried fire imbue: ranged attack, weapon+S d6 fire on hit; up to 2 others within 5 ft take S fire, and primary target Burns 1d4 next turn. Glacial Thorn requires 2 ranged+1 melee among those 3 hits: ranged attack weapon+S d6 cold; on hit STR save or Speed 0 until end next turn. Venomlash requires poisoned/blighted terrain at you or target: ranged attack weapon+S d6 poison; on hit CON save or-1 damage on its next attack. Spirit Fang requires quarry: ranged attack at advantage, weapon+S d6 force; ignores resistance but not immunity on the added force only. Cleansing Grove requires natural terrain at you or target: up to 3 living allies within 10 ft of a point within 60 ft each end Frightened or Poisoned; no attack or damage.

card.name: Track Target
card.effect: You have advantage on Survival checks to follow its physical tracks for 1 hour after the mark ends. While it is marked, once/turn your first hit also ignores 2 points of nonmagical flat damage reduction. Does not pierce immunity or reveal through cover.

source.originalText: Track Target: Mark an enemy to deal +10% damage and enable special abilities against them.

card.name: Pathfinder's Mark
card.rangeAndTarget: One fixed visible point within 30 ft
card.effect: Know direction and rough distance to the point within 10 miles on same plane. A new mark replaces old. It does not create teleportation, observe occupants or reveal a path through barriers.

source.originalText: Pathfinder's Mark: Place a magical mark on a location that you can sense the direction and distance to for 24 hours.

card.name: Predator's Mark
card.effect: Upgrade current mark: first direct weapon hit per turn adds 1d6 rather than the engine's flat S; choose the higher, not both. Know quarry direction while within 90 ft unless blocked by total cover. Requires concentration; ordinary mark remains if this upgrade ends.

source.originalText: Predator's Mark: Mark a tracked target for bonus damage and enhanced awareness of their movements (level 9).

card.name: Rootcall Quake
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in 10 ft-radius ground area within 60 ft
card.effect: STR save or Speed 0. Each affected target repeats save at end of each turn and may use Action to attempt escape using STR(Athletics) against class DC. Flying creatures not touching ground are unaffected.

source.originalText: Rootcall Quake: Create an area effect that roots enemies in place.

card.name: Toxic Affinity
card.effect: Immune to Poisoned and nonmagical disease; gain poison resistance. This deliberately replaces blanket immunity to every poison/disease source. Existing magical diseases require their own treatment.

source.originalText: Toxic Affinity: Gain immunity to poison and disease.

card.name: Venom Rain
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in 10 ft-radius area within 60 ft
card.duration: Instant; Poisoned until end next turn
card.effect: CON save: S d8 poison, half on success; failure Poisoned until end next turn. No permanent Corruption gain, contagious disease or poison harvesting. This is a paid technique and does not build Hit Chain.

source.originalText: Venom Rain: Create an area effect that deals poison damage and applies Corruption.

card.name: Plague Bearer
card.effect: Your first weapon hit each turn adds 1d6 poison; target CON save or Poisoned until end next turn. You lose M real HP on activation, cannot fall below 1. The controlled effect is not a transmissible permanent disease and creates no free toxins.

source.originalText: Plague Bearer: Infect yourself with a controlled disease that spreads to enemies you damage.

records.text: Totem Casting is Action 2 RP, duration 3 of your turns, 15 ft aura. Choose Flame, Stone, Frost, Spirit or Renewal. Benefits require an ally/target in the aura, maximum 3 creatures benefiting per pulse/round chosen by you. Flame adds 1 fire to an ally's first direct weapon hit per round; on critical that target Burns 1d4 next turn. Stone reduces damage by 1 and gives enemies-1 to STR checks to shove. Frost: enemy first entering/starting each round makes CON save or Speed-10 ft until end its turn. Spirit: first necrotic/hex damage per target per round adds 1. Renewal: on start and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action+1 RP maintenance, up to 3 allies regain 2 HP. Thus Renewal total cost 4 RP for 3 pulses; no free healing on entry. All totems share one concentration burden; losing it ends all. Other concentration effects replace them. Non-Renewal auras need no Bonus Action upkeep. Multiple same-name/stat auras do not stack.

Flask tier uses S. Mundane Base modes: Burn=one enemy 30 ft DEX save S d6 fire half, failure 1d4 fire next turn; Root=one ground enemy 30 ft STR save Speed 0 until end its next turn; Weaken=one enemy 30 ft CON save or-1 attack damage until end its next turn. Advanced Hero modes additionally: Stun=one enemy 30 ft CON save or no Reactions, failure by 10 Stunned until end its next turn; Heal=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Restore=end Frightened or Poisoned on one ally 30 ft. Every thrown flask consumes one prepared unit and 2 RP for advanced magic (Base mundane flasks cost 0 RP). Changing payload requires no separate crafting action when throwing. No flask leaves harvestable poison or another flask.

card.name: Flask Use
card.effect: Throw a Burn, Root or Weaken flask using the exact engine profile. At Hero 10 Theurgist/Soothsayer may instead throw an advanced mode as Bonus Action for 2 RP and a prepared flask. Bloodcaller does not gain that upgrade.

source.originalText: Flask Use: Create and throw elemental bombs (2 per encounter) that cause various effects.

card.name: Enhanced Elemental Attunement
card.effect: Fire adds 1 to first fire damage roll; Ice's slow increases to 10 ft; Air also gives+1 initiative; Earth adds+1 to CON concentration saves. These replace corresponding basic affinity quantities rather than duplicating them.

source.originalText: Enhanced Elemental Attunement: Your chosen element grants additional benefits to your abilities.

card.name: Summon Ice Wisp
card.rangeAndTarget: One spirit in empty space within 30 ft
card.effect: Summon standard Ice Wisp with fly 30 ft. Commanded attack deals cold; on hit target STR save or Speed 0 until end its next turn. No whole-turn freezing, bonus independent spells or multiple companion attacks.

source.originalText: Summon Ice Wisp: Call forth a spirit of frost that can snare and freeze enemies.

records.text: Overwatch is an automatic Base engine at 1. Bonus Action designate a visible 15 ft square within weapon range until start next regular turn. Once during that interval, spend your Reaction when a perceived enemy enters, moves inside, attacks an ally from, or reveals itself inside the zone. Make one legal ranged attack with ammunition and line of fire, normally 1d8+DEX piercing. On hit choose Snare (Speed-10 ft until end next turn), Bleed (1d4 at start next turn), or Push 5 ft (STR save negates push). Concealment still applies. Only one Overwatch zone; no extra Reaction. The optional Overwatch card upgrades this engine. At 17 you may move 5 ft without opportunity attacks after its shot, once/round.

source.originalText: Suppression Fire: Create a zone that enemies must save against or take damage when entering.

card.name: Hold the Line

card.effect: Make one melee weapon attack. On hit normal damage and STR save or Speed 0. This is soft movement control; teleportation and forced movement remain possible.

source.originalText: Hold the Line: Establish a defensive position that grants bonuses to allies behind you.

card.name: Guardian's Rush

card.effect: Move up to 15 ft along open ground to adjacent ally without opportunity attacks; reduce that hit's damage by 2 S+M. Cannot act while restrained or incapacitated. Does not transfer target or negate unrelated riders.

source.originalText: Guardian's Rush: Move adjacent to an ally being attacked, potentially intercepting the blow.

card.name: Divine Lockdown
card.effect: STR save each; failure Speed 0 and cannot take Reactions. Success Speed-10 ft only. This is physical suppression; teleport remains possible. No damage or additional free attacks.

source.originalText: Divine Lockdown: Prevent enemy movement in a small area (once per encounter).

card.name: Net Bolt
card.effect: Ranged weapon attack; on hit S d4 bludgeoning and Restrained. Target or adjacent ally may use Action STR/Athletics against your DC to end, or destroy net AC 10 HP 5. Huge or larger targets instead lose 10 ft Speed. No automatic unsaveable imprisonment.

source.originalText: Net Bolt: Fire a specialized bolt that snares the target on hit (no save).

card.effect: Mark foe. It takes-1 saves against your class effects and deals 1 less damage on its first hit against an ally other than you. One mark; penalty does not stack with Intimidating Presence.

source.originalText: Marked for Death: Enemies you designate take –1 to saves and deal –1 damage vs allies other than you.

card.name: Crippling Strike
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy hit by your Sneak Attack
card.effect: Target CON save; failure Speed halved. Does not stack multiple slow fractions or deny teleport. Explicit Arch minimum 15 retained.

source.originalText: Crippling Strike: Your Sneak Attack applies Slow effect to the target (level 15).

records.text: At 5 automatically gain one module slot; change module during long rest. Offensive: Burn Injector first bolt hit/turn causes 1d4 fire next 2 target turns; Poison Vents d4=4 on hit CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn; Concussive Bolt d4=4 on hit CON save or Stunned until end next turn, once/target/encounter shared denial guard and 1/short-rest successful Stun. Support: Ammo Dispenser adjacent allies first ranged hit/turn+1 damage; Target Scanner command mark 1 visible foe 60 ft first ally attack before start next turn+1 hit; Tether Grappler command once/encounter pulls 1 willing ally 15 ft within 30 ft without opportunity attacks along open route.

Overload Core destroys one commanded drone within 30 ft as part Action bomb, DEX save 2d6 lightning and no Reactions until end next turn on failure, half damage on success. Consumes stock/allowance; no further destruction proc.

Sentry and Net require their cards. Additional engine profiles unlocked 6: Rocket Tower commanded attack 60 ft target DEX save S d6 fire/half success to up to 2 creatures within 5 ft, maximum 3 shots; Decoy Dummy one foe 30 ft WIS save when deployed or disadvantage on next attack against others, destruction S fire to one adjacent enemy no chain; Blast Wall 10-by 5 ft blocks LOS and movement, climb cost 10 ft. Net Trap one enemy entry STR save or Restrained, end turn repeat/Action escape DC, 3 round max then ends. One only fires when commanded except nonattack trap/decoy trigger; command budget limits damaging triggers too.

source.originalText: Bomb Specialization: Your explosive devices deal additional damage or have enhanced effects.

card.name: Deploy Net Trap
card.effect: Deploy visible Net Trap. First enemy entry STR save or Restrained, repeat end turn or Action escape against DC. Target Huge+instead speed-10 ft. No damage or continued rearming; ends after one creature escapes.

source.originalText: Deploy Net Trap: Set a trap that roots enemies who trigger it (level 6).

card.name: Overpressure Bombs
card.effect: Add on failed initial save STR save or choose push 10 ftor Prone. Also add S damage to one failed-save target. No additional blast or compounded slow; do not stack with Thermobaric push.

source.originalText: Overpressure Bombs: Your bombs gain knockback or prone effects with enhanced elemental damage.

card.name: Brutality Sense
card.rangeAndTarget: Hostile creatures you can perceive within 60 feet
card.effect: Brutality Sense. You know when a visible hostile creature is at or below one-quarter of its maximum HP; it is Vulnerable for your Warrior features that specifically reference a marked vulnerable target. This does not reveal its exact HP or hidden resistances.

source.originalText: Brutality Sense: You can sense when an opponent is below 25% health, marking them as vulnerable.

card.name: Brutality Momentum
card.effect: Brutality Momentum. When you personally reduce a creature marked Vulnerable by Brutality Sense to 0 HP with a melee attack, set Brutal Strike's positive round-recharge counter to 0 if it has not already been reset or shortened this round. This restores no Action and cannot refresh a per-rest use. Trivial, summoned or friendly creatures cannot trigger it.

source.originalText: Brutality Momentum: Killing a marked vulnerable target instantly readies your next Brutal Strike.

card.name: Stabilizing Injection
card.frequency: At most once per target per long rest
card.effect: Stabilizing Injection. The target regains 2d8 + M HP and may end one of Poisoned, Frightened or Staggered. If Diseased, it may immediately repeat one saving throw the disease normally permits. This removes no Wounds, cannot restore the dead and does not activate a mutation or apply the consumed serum's normal profile.

source.originalText: Stabilizing Injection: Use your serum knowledge to create a stabilizing agent that can heal and remove negative status effects.

card.name: Cellular Reconstruction
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn, then instantaneous recovery
card.effect: Cellular Reconstruction. Enter stasis until the start of your next regular turn: your Speed becomes 0, you cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions, and attacks against you have advantage. At the start of your next turn regain 3d8 + M HP and end Poisoned plus one mundane or magical disease that does not explicitly require a special cure. This removes no Wounds and cannot function while dead.

source.originalText: Cellular Reconstruction: Enter a brief stasis where your body rapidly heals and purges toxins or diseases.

card.name: Infectious Mutation
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your weapon or natural attack
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Infectious Mutation. After you hit a creature, roll a d10. On a 10, painful temporary growths erupt: the target takes S psychic damage and has -1 on its next attack roll or saving throw before the end of its next turn, whichever occurs first. This is not a permanent mutation, disease or body alteration and cannot spread or reproduce.

source.originalText: Infectious Mutation: Your attacks have a 10% chance to cause minor, painful mutations in your targets.

card.name: Shoulder Spike Cluster
card.rangeAndTarget: Creature grappling you or grappled by you
card.effect: When a grapple is established or maintained against you, or you successfully establish a grapple, the other creature takes 1d6 piercing damage.

source.originalText: | Shoulder Spike Cluster | When grappling or being grappled, attacker takes 1d6 damage |

records.text: MATRIX MASTERY MODIFICATIONS. After acquiring Matrix Mastery, each prepared ordinary spell matrix may carry at most one modification chosen during preparation. QUICK SUBSTITUTION: once per short rest, replace one matrix marked Quick Substitution with another spellbook spell of exactly the same rank using a 1-minute ritual instead of the normal 10-minute midday swap; the replacement loses the modification until the next long rest. COMPONENT ENHANCEMENT: when casting a damaging or healing matrix, spend 1 additional RP to add one extra die of the spell's primary damage or healing die to one roll; if the spell has no such die this modification has no effect. MATRIX LINKING: pair two different prepared matrix families during preparation; after legally casting one, the other costs 1 less RP, minimum 1, if cast before the end of your next regular turn, at most once per pair per round. STABILITY REINFORCEMENT: gain +2 on concentration saves caused by damage while maintaining that matrix. A matrix modification never creates another spell cast or proc event.

card.name: Analyze Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One magical creature, object or effect within 30 feet
card.effect: Analyze Magic. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, divination, knowledge. Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + the effect's spell rank, treating a non-spell effect's Director-assigned tier as rank. On success learn its school or magical category, one active mechanical property and whether it is currently sustained, cursed or bound to another effect. Failure reveals only that magic is present.

source.originalText: Analyze Magic: Study a magical effect or item to gain insight into its properties and function.

card.name: Arcane Sight
card.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

card.name: Sigil Authority
card.effect: Sigil Authority. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive. Gain +1 on Counterspell and Dispel Magic ability checks. When a creature is Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Restrained or Stunned by a source other than the spell you are currently casting, your Spellbinder spells that force it to save use a Wizard spell DC 2 higher. This increase never applies retroactively to the condition that enabled it.

source.originalText: Sigil Authority: +1 to all counterspell rolls, +2 DC vs targets currently affected by crowd control

card.name: Runic Snare
card.effect: Runic Snare. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, glyph, control. Place a visible-to-you glyph. The first hostile creature entering the square makes a Dexterity save. Failure deals S d6 force damage, causes Restrained until the end of its next turn and makes it drop one non-attuned held item of its choice. Success takes half damage with no restraint or drop. A Restrained target may repeat a Strength save at the end of its turn.

source.originalText: Runic Snare: Glyph trap explodes in a 2x2 root + disarm on trigger

card.name: Will Domination
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature that fails a save against your Wizard spell by 5 or more
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Will Domination. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, control. When a creature's total on a saving throw against your Wizard spell is at least 5 below the DC, it is Stunned until the end of its next turn. After this successfully Stuns that creature once in the encounter, later qualifying failures instead remove its Reaction until the end of its next turn. This uses the shared source-character/target hard-denial mark across all your features, not a separate allowance per spell.

source.originalText: Will Domination: Creatures that fail saves against your spells by 5+ are stunned for 1 round.

card.name: Binding Sigil
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature directly affected by your Wizard spell
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most one marked creature at a time
card.effect: Binding Sigil. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, mark. After one creature takes damage from or fails a save against your Wizard spell, you may mark it. Until the end of your next regular turn you have advantage on Wizard spell attacks against that creature. Marking another creature ends the previous mark. Echoes, companions and environmental damage cannot apply it.

source.originalText: Binding Sigil: Mark a creature, giving you advantage on spell attacks against it.

card.name: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock)
card.effect: Infernal Pact — Gravebrand. Tags: hero, necromancer, infernal, necrotic, dark-content. This card can be selected only after completing the campaign's Infernal Pact quest and its dark-trauma check-in. Mark one creature. At the start of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save; on failure it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you regain HP equal to the actual damage dealt, maximum S+M; success ends Gravebrand. Gravebrand ignores necrotic resistance but not immunity. While you possess this Pact, Corpse Harvest and Auto-Raise may also treat Fiend corpses as eligible; other creature types remain ineligible.

source.originalText: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock): Grants Gravebrand: 1d6 necrotic per round, heals caster, overrides corpse resistance

card.name: Mental Binding
card.effect: Mental Binding. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, enchantment, control, concentration. Target WIS save; failure becomes Charmed for at most 3 rounds, repeat save at end each turn and on damage. On its first affected turn only, choose Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel or Strike; target uses up to half Speed, one object interaction or one ordinary weapon attack as appropriate, consuming its normal Action only if an attack is made. This command replaces at most one normal Action/turn and uses the shared hard-denial mark. Later turns retain normal actions, but while Charmed it cannot willingly attack you. No self-harm, compelled beliefs, resource expenditure or permanent allegiance. The player chooses the safest legal interpretation for a PC.

source.originalText: Mental Binding: Force a creature to obey a simple command for a short duration.

card.name: Arcane Domination
card.effect: Arcane Domination. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, enchantment, control, concentration. Target WIS save; failure Charmed for 1 minute, repeat at end each turn and on damage. Once during this effect, spend Bonus Action to command its NEXT normal turn: Move up to Speed and either Dodge, Disengage or make one ordinary weapon attack, replacing its normal Action and using the shared hard-denial mark. It gains no extra turn or attack; later turns retain normal actions while Charmed, with no Reactions until effect ends. A PC chooses its legal attack target and reasonable route. No self-harm, forced spell/resource expenditure, belief change or permanent control.

source.originalText: Arcane Domination: Take control of a creature's actions for 1 minute.

card.name: Mind Prison
card.effect: Mind Prison. Tags: hero, necromancer, final-theorem, enchantment, illusion, control, concentration. Target WIS save; failure Incapacitated until end of its NEXT normal turn, using the shared hard-denial mark. During that one turn you may spend a Bonus Action on your turn to specify one replacement behavior: target moves up to half Speed and either Dodges or makes one ordinary weapon attack instead of its lost Action; a PC chooses its own attack target and route. After that first affected turn, no further Action denial or compelled attack occurs: while concentration continues, target Speed is halved and it cannot take Reactions. It repeats WIS save at end each turn and on damage, ending on success. Maximum 3 rounds. No forced self-harm, spell expenditure, transfer of equipment, confession, belief change or permanent allegiance.

source.originalText: Mind Prison: Trap a creature's mind in an illusory reality while controlling its body (1/week).

operational.targets: Up to 5 willing falling creatures you can perceive within range
operational.duration: Until each target lands, stops falling, or immediately before the caster's regular turn ten rounds after casting (1 minute), whichever occurs first
operational.resolution: None; willing legal targets are affected automatically.
operational.effect: Slow each target's downward descent to at most 60 feet at each once-per-round Fall Marker. Use the new provisional falling bridge in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md: dissipate prior uncontrolled momentum on application; if landing while this spell is active, impact is min(3, floor(total distance descended in this fall / 20))d6 bludgeoning. This impact limit is a new playtest decision, not recovered spell text.
operational.scaling: None; maximum descent remains 60 feet per round and target cap remains 5.

On expiry aloft, reset uncontrolled distance to zero and resume ordinary descent at the existing marker with no immediate extra step. Expiry resolves before a coincident Falling Step.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 consistently gives Action, 60-foot range, V/S/F components and the five-creature/60-feet-per-round effect, but lists Instantaneous duration despite sustained descent. Duration, initiative marker, momentum handling and impact formula are NEW provisional decisions agreed with the GPT notebook. See SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for the full procedure and source-search limits. This does not import a Reaction casting time or automatic fall-damage immunity. F is an existing class casting focus.
